name: personal-outlook-mcp
description: Read and act on your personal Outlook inbox and calendar from Claude.
long_description: Exposes a personal Outlook (consumer Microsoft account) inbox and calendar to MCP clients via Microsoft Graph. Uses MSAL device-code flow for OAuth and stores tokens in the OS keyring (macOS Keychain). You bring your own Azure AD app registration; tokens never leave your machine. **This .mcpb bundle is built for macOS arm64 only.** Other platforms should install via `npx -y @jaingxyz/personal-outlook-mcp` instead.

tools.name: personal_email_list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders with id, display name, unread/total counts.

tools.name: personal_email_search
tools.description: Free-text or KQL search across the mailbox.

tools.name: personal_email_read
tools.description: Fetch one message with full body.

tools.name: personal_email_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a message read or unread.

tools.name: personal_email_move
tools.description: Move a message to another folder.

tools.name: personal_email_reply
tools.description: Reply to a message by id.

tools.name: personal_email_download_attachment
tools.description: Save a file attachment to disk.

tools.name: personal_calendar_list_events
tools.description: Events in a date range, recurring series expanded.

tools.name: personal_calendar_respond_to_invite
tools.description: Accept / tentatively / decline a meeting invite.

azure_client_id.title: Azure AD App (client) ID
azure_client_id.description: Application (client) ID from your own Azure AD app registration. See https://github.com/jaingxyz/personal-outlook-mcp#azure-setup for the 5-minute setup.

azure_tenant.title: Azure tenant
azure_tenant.description: Tenant identifier. 'consumers' for personal Microsoft accounts, 'common' to also accept work/school, or a specific tenant GUID.

timezone.title: Display timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used to render calendar event times (e.g. America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, Europe/London).
